items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex stuck in range; Vedanta Power, IDBI Bank lead SmallCap gains
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Wednesday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap fell 0.27 per cent and 0.16 per cent, respectively

items.title: Bank of Baroda down 3%, top loser among PSU Banks; why is stock falling?
items.description: Bank of Baroda's share price dipped 3% in Wednesday's trade following reports that NMC Healthcare group filed a lawsuit seeking $15 billion in damages. BoB said it has not received any Court notice

items.title: Bharat Coking Coal share price zooms over 7% after raw material price hike
items.description: The company approved an increase of approximately 0.1 per cent to 14 per cent in the basic prices of select grades of raw coking coal for the non-regulated sector.

items.title: Tech Mahindra Q2 preview: PAT may jump 30-40% YoY; firm to mull bonus issue
items.description: Tech Mahindra's board will mull a dividend payout and a bonus issue along with the Q2 results announcement.

items.title: Hero Motors jumps 8% after Q1 profit doubles; stock up 100% from IPO level
items.description: For the April-June quarter, Hero Motors has reported a consolidated profit of ₹10.20 crore, up 116 per cent on a Y-o-Y basis.

items.title: Urban Company jumps 3% on fundraising plans; JM Fin calls the step prudent
items.description: Urban Company share price: JM Financial said that this is a "step in the right direction" amidst high competitive pressures in the instant house-help segment.

items.title: Transformers and Rectifiers soars 14% on strong Q2; stock up 28% in October
items.description: Transformers and Rectifiers (TRIL)'s order book provides comfortable revenue visibility, while the Changodar expansion positions it to service a larger opportunity pipeline, says ICICI Securities.

items.title: Vinay Rajani favours buy-on-dips in Nifty; bets on HAL, Karnataka Bank
items.description: Vinay Rajani of HDFC Securities has recommended buy-on-dips in Nifty, as support has shifted higher to 22,580, followed by 22,300. Besides, he has also shared a bullish view on HAL and Karnataka Bank

items.title: Tata Elxsi shares gain over 7% after Q2 results; brokerages remain split
items.description: Tata Elxsi reported a 10 per cent year-on-year rise in net profit for the September quarter. The company's net profit for the quarter ended September stood at ₹170 crore.

items.title: Fusion CX IPO: Brokerages mixed; customer concentration a key concern
items.description: Fusion CX IPO review: Brokerages have shared mixed ratings on Fusion CX Ltd IPO. SBI Securities has recommended 'Subscribe' rating, while Swastika has rated it 'Neutral'.

items.title: Asian stocks rise as chipmakers rebound ahead of US inflation data
items.description: Among ​firms in the AI supply chain, chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix rose more than 2% in ‌South Korea while Kioxia was steady in Japan

items.title: FPIs favour IPOs over listed stocks for 3rd year running; will trend last?
items.description: In 2026 alone, FPIs have poured in ₹55,524 crore into the primary market, while selling in the secondary market hit a record ₹3.15 trillion till September so far.

items.title: Technical view: Chandan Taparia bullish on HAL, Shriram Finance & 1 more
items.description: Chandan Taparia has said Nifty has given an inside bar breakout in the previous session, indicating a strong recovery. If Nifty holds above 22,700, it may bounce towards 22,850 and then 23,000 levels.
